translation.text: The Federation made a grave mistake in interfering.

m.english: Everyone here is under arrest for crimes against the federation.

target.text: Todos os presentes estão presos por crimes contra a Federação.

m.english: I give the floor to the representative of the Russian Federation.

target.text: Dou a palavra ao representante da Federação Russa.

m.target: Dou a palavra ao representante da Federação Russa.

m.english: Our Director wishes you all a happy celebration of Federation.

target.text: O nosso Director deseja a todos um dia feliz na Federação.

translation.text: Our Director wishes you all a happy celebration of Federation.

m.target: O nosso Director deseja a todos um dia feliz na Federação.

m.english: Millions of souls from every Federation world holding hands.

translation.text: Millions of souls from every Federation world holding hands.

m.target: Milhões de almas... de todos os mundos da Federação de mãos dadas.

m.english: One of the advantages of being light years away from Federation headquarters.

m.target: Uma das vantagens de estarmos anos luz fora da sede da Federação.

u.english: Prime Minister, this plan, I believe, is in our Federation's best interests. We'll need a distraction.

u.english: Federation's newest and most advanced starbase.
